what_happened: Empirically measured (fabricated-HOME claude mcp list fixture, with key-order and unrelated-repo controls) that Claude Code's own ~/.claude.json per-project lookup already resolves a linked git worktree to its main checkout's .projects entry, with no cross-repo bleed. This closes dispatch open-questions 1 and 2 by elimination: no worktree-specific ~/.claude.json entry is ever needed, so there is nothing to retract at teardown.

Research measured Claude Code's own ~/.claude.json per-project lookup rather than assuming it, which eliminated an entire anticipated work item (a worktree-entry teardown/retraction mechanism for dispatch open question 2) from the plan by construction instead of deferring it, and confirmed setup-sapience-mcp.sh needs no edit at all.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification honesty check evaluates suite_selection_select over a phase's COMBINED path set, so a phase mixing mapped and unmapped paths returns __FULL_SWEEP__ and any real per-path suite name in the justification is flagged as fabricated. Resolved by stating the sentinel verdict in the justification and keeping the real suite invocations in the phase's Verification criteria instead.
